evals.name: chapter-from-written-style-guide
evals.prompt: Our faculty's thesis formatting guide is FACULTY_STYLE_GUIDE.md in this folder, and sample_report_2025.docx shows how a finished report looks. Write Chapter 3 (Method) of my thesis on rendering latency in digital test pattern viewers — the raw notes are in notes.md, and viewer_screenshot.png is the figure I want in there. Save it as Chapter_03.docx.
evals.expected_output: A Chapter_03.docx written from the notes in English, formatted to the faculty's guide (A4, 2.5 cm margins, Times New Roman 12 pt, justified, 1.5 line spacing, heading sizes 14/16/14 pt, centred caption above the figure), plus a compliance report showing the document matches the guide.

evals.name: audit-and-fix-legacy-report
evals.prompt: ช่วยตรวจสอบ legacy_report_2024.docx ว่าตรงกับเกณฑ์การเขียนใน FACULTY_STYLE_GUIDE.md ไหม แล้วแก้ให้ตรงตามกฎ ให้ผมรายการของข้อที่ผิดพลาดพร้อม ID ของกฎด้วย
evals.expected_output: A rule-ID-indexed audit of the legacy report, the file corrected so it complies with the guide, and the corrected file left in the project folder alongside the audit.

evals.name: full-book-skeleton
evals.prompt: Build me the complete thesis book skeleton for my internship report as a .docx: both covers, copyright, Thai and English abstract, certification sheet, acknowledgements, table of contents, list of tables, list of figures, abbreviations, chapters 1 to 5, references, appendix and author biography. Use the house style described in RULES.md in this folder. Pull the project facts (title, what the project does, the five chapters' topics) from the repository you are in, and mark anything you could not find instead of inventing it.
evals.expected_output: A single .docx containing the whole book in the house style, with every mandated part present in order, real TOC/list fields, and placeholders rather than invented content where the facts were missing.

evals.name: derive-profile-from-existing-parts
evals.prompt: โปรเจกต์นี้มีรายงานที่เขียนไว้แล้วใน docs/thesis/*.docx และไฟล์กฎ docs/RULES.md ช่วยสร้าง style profile ที่อธิบายรูปแบบจริงของเล่มนี้ แล้วตรวจว่าแต่ละไฟล์ตรงกับ profile หรือไม่ พร้อมบอกว่ากฎข้อไหนที่ไฟล์ใช้ค่าอื่น
evals.expected_output: A house_style.json produced by scripts/derive_profile.py over every part (not one file), containing measured page geometry, fonts, heading sizes, indent mode, caption placement and footer, plus a rule_deltas list naming each disagreement with evidence; then a per-file compliance table whose lines quote the rule IDs from rules.ids.

evals.name: audit-folder-with-project-profile
evals.prompt: ตรวจรายงานทั้งโฟลเดอร์ (ทุก part .docx) ว่าเข้ากับเฟอร์แมตเล่มหรือไม่ แล้วสรุปเป็นตารางว่าข้อไหนไม่ผ่านพร้อม ID ของกฎ
evals.expected_output: Every .docx in the folder checked with the project profile and --mode chapter (Word lock files skipped), reported as one table of file / pass / fail / failing check names, plus one line per cause with its rule ID and the number of affected runs or paragraphs — and no claim of compliance while a FAIL remains.
